name: personalclaw.dev

scripts.dev: npm run sync && ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro dev
scripts.build: npm run sync && npm run check:astro && npm run build:site
scripts.build:preview: npm run sync && VERCEL_ENV=preview ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro build --outDir .preview-dist
scripts.check: npm run sync && npm run check:astro
scripts.test:static: npm run validate:visual-baselines && npm run validate:marketing-manifest && npm run validate:design-tokens && npm run validate:release-parity && npm run build && npm run validate:build && npm run validate:blog && npm run build:preview && npm run validate:preview && npm run validate:registry
scripts.test:visual:update: npm run build && playwright test tests/browser/visual.spec.ts --update-snapshots
scripts.test:ci: npm run test:static && playwright test && node scripts/lighthouse-audit.mjs
scripts.sync: npm run sync:sources && npm run sync:docs && npm run sync:registry

//overrides: sharp: Astro 7 allows ^0.34 || ^0.35 and npm resolved 0.34.5, which carries the libvips advisory GHSA-f88m-g3jw-g9cj (4 CVEs, high). Astro already permits the patched line, so this pins the resolution up rather than adding sharp as a direct dependency the site does not import. Drop when Astro floors it itself.
